# Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen solution and any important trade-offs.

Fixes #

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual journeys used to verify this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change respects the monorepo boundaries.
- [ ] Types, validation and failure states are explicit.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior or regression.
- [ ] Database migrations are safe and documented when applicable.
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard accessible and responsive.
- [ ] Documentation and environment examples are current.
- [ ] No secret, generated output or local configuration is included.
